Control bar: bold section labels, lighter control text.

scores.transition_note: All six layout transitions interpolate node positions smoothly via cx/cy with 600ms cubic-in-out easing and no offscreen flight or origin clustering. Minor deductions: labels snap their rotation/transform immediately via .each() outside the transition rather than animating, and the randomize-dataset transition briefly shows 20 undersized nodes at 100ms before resolving by 350ms. Rapid switching and edge bundling both work cleanly with no orphaned elements.
scores.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with coordinated Tableau10 palette and smooth bundled edges looks deliberately crafted, but label placement is naive (all offset right with no anchor adjustment for non-radial layouts) and the circle-pack view scatters nodes without visual grouping cues, making the hierarchy harder to read than the interaction quality deserves.
